# nyc_streets <img src="man/figures/nycstreets.png" align="right" width="360">

## Installation

You can install the development version of nycstreets from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("kjhealy/nycstreets")
```

## The dataset

```{r example}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(nycstreets)
nyc_streets_sf
```


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
nyc_streets_sf |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(linewidth = 0.1) +
  theme_void()
```
